issues.issue: Is there a reasonable possibility that an extension of time to file the late leave application will be granted, so that the JR raises a serious issue?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant says he learned of the RAD decision on February 13, 2025, did not know of the 15-day limit, and always intended review.
issues.respondent_position: Respondent opposes the extension: not knowing the 15-day limit is no reasonable explanation for a two-month delay.
issues.result_quote: there is no reasonable possibility that an extension of time to file and serve that application will be granted

issues.issue: Does the underlying judicial review raise a serious issue on its merits (not frivolous or vexatious)?
issues.respondent_position: Respondent opposes the application for leave on its merits.
issues.result_quote: there is no merit to the grounds raised in the application for judicial review

issues.issue: Would the applicant suffer irreparable harm, and does the balance of convenience favour a stay?
issues.result_quote: There is no need to address either irreparable harm or the balance of convenience.
